# Programs of MLton's regression suite that tests/external/run-mlton.sh
# skips: one per line, the name, a space and CATEGORY: reason.
#   EXTENSION   needs an extension of MLton or SML/NJ (MLton.*, SMLofNJ.*, a
#               WordN or IntN of a width the specification does not have)
#   DEFINITION  MLton accepts or types the program where the Definition
#               rejects it or leaves the choice to the implementation
#   WIDTH       assumes MLton's 32-bit int or word, or its size limits
#   READING     MLton reads the specification otherwise (or departs from it)
#   HARNESS     needs files, a program name or merged output that the runner
#               does not provide
#   SLOW        does not finish in the runner's 20 seconds on the interpreter
#   SCOPE       needs a part of the Basis Library that Rune leaves out
# Remove a line when its program passes.
abstype DEFINITION: MLton treats abstype as a datatype; the Definition forbids equality on the type outside the body (rule 19)
args-create EXTENSION: MLton.Process
args-spawn EXTENSION: MLton.Process
binio SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (passes in about 100 s)
callcc EXTENSION: MLton.Cont
callcc2 EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.Cont.callcc
callcc3 EXTENSION: MLton
cmdline HARNESS: prints CommandLine.name, which MLton's run gives as ./cmdline
command-line HARNESS: prints CommandLine.name, which MLton's run gives as ./command-line
conv WIDTH: assumes a 32-bit int, MLton's default; Rune's has 64 bits
conversion DEFINITION: MLton types the word constants of x8 from a later declaration (as Word8.word); Rune resolves overloading at the end of each top-level declaration (Appendix E allows it) and defaults them to word
date-localOffset EXTENSION: MLton.ProcEnv.setenv
eq EXTENSION: MLton.eq
exn-history EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.exnHistory
exn-history3 EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.exnHistory
fast SLOW: too slow on the interpreter
filesys HARNESS: needs the file README and the links testlink, testcycl and testbadl where it runs
finalize EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
finalize.2 EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
finalize.3 EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
finalize.4 EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
finalize.5 EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
finalize.6 EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
fixed-integer EXTENSION: Int2 ... Int64, widths the specification does not have
flat-array.4 EXTENSION: Word14, a width the specification does not have
gc-collect EXTENSION: MLton.GC.collect
gc-collect2 EXTENSION: MLton.GC.collect
general WIDTH: expects Array.array (Array.maxLen + 1, ()) to overflow (MLton's maxLen is maxInt); Rune's maxLen is 100000000, so it raises Size
harmonic SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
int-inf.2 WIDTH: assumes a 32-bit int, MLton's default; Rune's has 64 bits
int-inf.5 EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
int-inf.compare DEFINITION: MLton types an integer constant from a later declaration; Rune resolves overloading at the end of each top-level declaration (Appendix E allows it) and defaults the constant to int
int-inf.rep1 EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
int-inf.rep2 EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
int-inf.rep3 EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
int-inf.rep4 EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
int-inf.rep5 EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
int-overflow WIDTH: expects Int.fromString to overflow at 32 bits; Rune's int has 64
kitsimple SLOW: too slow on the interpreter
mlton.overload EXTENSION: MLton's _overload declaration
mlton.share EXTENSION: MLton.share
mlton.word EXTENSION: MLton.Word
mutex EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
nextAfter READING: nextAfter (r, t) returns r when r = t, as the specification says, so nextAfter (~0.0, 0.0) is ~0.0; MLton returns t, as C's nextafter does (docs/basis-compat.md)
once EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.Cont
pack EXTENSION: MLton.GC
prodcons EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
real READING: MLton prints ~0.0 without its sign under SCI, FIX and GEN (docs/basis-compat.md), fuses Real64 *+, makes a numeral with a huge exponent INF in IEEEReal.fromString, and computes Real32.rem inexactly (rem (maxFinite, 1230.0) is 0.2E32, not below 1230)
real-int WIDTH: converts ints from Int.minInt on, which has 32 bits in MLton; Rune's int has 64
real-str READING: Real.fromDecimal rounds in the current rounding mode; MLton rounds to nearest in every mode
rlimit EXTENSION: MLton.Rlimit
same-fringe EXTENSION: MLton.Thread
serialize EXTENSION: MLton
signals EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
signals2 EXTENSION: MLton.Thread
signals3 EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
signals4 EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
size EXTENSION: MLton.size
slow SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
slow2 SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
slower SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (passes in about 8 minutes)
smith-normal-form SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
socket DEFINITION: MLton resolves undetermined top-level types across declarations (the mode of a socket); the Definition rejects them (rules 87-89)
string READING: MLton expects String.fromCString to give SOME "" where no character converts; the specification says NONE
string.fromString READING: String.fromString converts an unescaped double quote, the reading of SML/NJ and Poly/ML (docs/basis-compat.md); MLton stops at it
suspend EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
test-create EXTENSION: MLton.Process
test-spawn EXTENSION: MLton.Process
textio HARNESS: the expected output is stdOut and stdErr merged; the runner compares stdOut
textio.2 SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (passes in about 100 s)
thread-switch EXTENSION: MLton
thread-switch-share EXTENSION: MLton.Thread.Runnable.t
thread-switch-size EXTENSION: MLton.Thread.Runnable.t
thread0 EXTENSION: MLton.Thread
thread1 EXTENSION: MLton
thread2 EXTENSION: MLton
timeout EXTENSION: MLton
undetermined DEFINITION: MLton resolves undetermined top-level types across declarations; the Definition rejects them (rules 87-89)
weak EXTENSION: MLton.Weak
weak.2 EXTENSION: MLton.Weak
weak.3 DEFINITION: val cache = ref [] gets its type from a later declaration, which MLton allows and the Definition rejects (rules 87-89); the program also needs MLton.Weak
weird-word1 EXTENSION: Word5, a width the specification does not have
weird-word2 EXTENSION: Word5, a width the specification does not have
widechar SCOPE: characters above 255 (WideChar, outside the plan's scope)
word WIDTH: assumes a 32-bit word, MLton's default; Rune's has 64 bits
word-all EXTENSION: Word2 ... Word31, widths the specification does not have
wordn-array EXTENSION: Word5, a width the specification does not have
world1 EXTENSION: MLton.World
world2 EXTENSION: MLton.World
world3 EXTENSION: MLton.World
world4 EXTENSION: MLton.World
world5 EXTENSION: MLton.World
world6 EXTENSION: MLton.World
